塞拉伦涅又浮现出了一段记忆。她想起了一座大厅，里面坐满了衣着考究的人，他们低沉而深思熟虑的语调中透着惯于发号施令者的自信。

“他们在争论，”她低声说道。“声音不大，但措辞犀利……是关于一项任务。关于一次必须保密的发射。还有其他的，还有两艘飞船和我们一起出发了。但为什么？我们到底在逃离什么？”
texts.en:
Another memory has surfaced for Seralune. She remembers a hall of impeccably dressed figures, their hushed, deliberate tones carrying the confidence of those used to command.

"They were arguing," she murmurs. "Not loudly, but sharply... about a mission. About a launch that had to stay secret. And there were others, two more ships, sent along with us. But why? Were we running from something?"

texts.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]星系没能提供多少答案。塞拉伦涅感到一种无法解释的熟悉感，而我们的扫描仪在恒星轨道上检测到了一块漂浮的人造残骸碎片。其结构暗示其采用了深空设计，但哪怕有什么标记或识别符号，也早就因时间而消逝。

“我曾希望来到这里能唤醒些什么，”她轻声说道。“但……还不是时候。”
texts.en:
The [fromfrom.GetName] system offers few answers. Seralune senses a familiarity she cannot explain, and our scans have detected a fragment of artificial debris drifting in the star's orbit. Its construction suggests deep-space design, but any markings or identifiers have long since faded.

"I hoped coming here would spark something," she says quietly. "But... not yet."

texts.zh:
我们的调查团队在[fromfrom.GetName]星系的残骸中发现了一个漂浮的小型数据水晶。它的外壳已经焦黑，但有一处细节依然清晰可见：一段旧注册码的碎片，字母为‘U-N-S’。它们的含义尚不明确，但水晶解密后的内容还包括一组精确的坐标。

与此同时，塞拉伦涅也找回了另一段记忆。她想起了一个巨大的观景台，星辰在寂静的观察窗外流淌，还有一只指引的手指向一颗蓝色的星球——那是距离其恒星最近的第三颗行星。
texts.en:
Our survey team has recovered a small data crystal drifting amid the debris in the [fromfrom.GetName] system. Its casing is scorched, but one detail remains clear: a fragment of an old registry code, the letters 'U N S'. Their meaning is unclear, but the crystal's decrypted contents also include a set of precise coordinates.

At the same time, Seralune has recovered another memory. She recalls a vast observation deck, stars spilling across a silent viewport, and a guiding hand pointing toward a blue world, the third planet from its sun.

与此同时，塞拉伦涅也找回了另一段记忆。她想起了一个巨大的观景台，星辰在寂静的观察窗外流淌，还有一只指引的手指向一颗蓝色的星球——那是距离其恒星最近的第三颗行星。
texts.en:
Our survey team has recovered a small data crystal drifting amid the debris in the [fromfrom.GetName] system. Its casing is scorched, but one detail remains clear: a fragment of an old registry code, the letters 'U N S'. The resemblance to our own historical markings is uncanny, but the crystal's decrypted contents also include a set of precise coordinates.

At the same time, Seralune has recovered another memory. She recalls a vast observation deck, stars spilling across a silent viewport, and a guiding hand pointing toward a blue world, the third planet from its sun.

label.zh: 我们必须帮她想起剩下的部分。
label.en: We must help her remember the rest.

label.en: Her past is irrelevant. We have what we need.

texts.zh:
塞拉伦涅浮现出了一段新的记忆。她回想起一艘巨大的世代飞船，其船体旨在承载整个未来。

随后是一次剧烈的震动：警报声响起，远处走廊里金属炸裂的火光闪现。她记得自己被一位女子抱起，带进了一个逃生舱。

“她紧紧抱着我。她说我必须活下去……说我太重要了。接着我就孤身一人了。我几乎能看见她的脸庞，但每次它都悄然逝去。”
texts.en:
A new memory has surfaced for Seralune. She recalls a vast generational ship, its hull designed to hold entire futures.

Then a violent shudder: alarms, a flash of exploding metal in a distant corridor. She remembers being lifted by a woman and carried to an escape pod.

"She held me close. She said I had to survive... that I was too important. And then I was alone. I can almost see her face, but it slips away every time."

label.zh: 世代飞船……像我们这艘一样的？

texts.zh:
对毁坏方舟舰的分析让我们深入了解了塞拉伦涅的起源。其内部结构和生命维持体系与她身上回收的碎片完全吻合。受损的日志中提到了一位指定的继承人，一个自出生起就接受培养、旨在有朝一日领导这艘飞船及其族群的个体。

记录证实，在结构崩解前的几秒钟内，只有一名未成年乘客被撤离。没有其他逃生舱发射。

“他们救了我，”她轻声说道。“我不只是个乘客……我本该领导他们，现在我恳求你帮我理解其中的原因。”
texts.en:
Analysis of the ruined Arkship has yielded significant insight into Seralune's origin. Its internal structure and life-support architecture match her recovered fragments exactly. Corrupted logs reference a designated heir, an individual trained from birth to one day guide the vessel and its people.

Records confirm that only a single juvenile passenger was evacuated seconds before structural failure. No other pods were launched.

"They saved me," she says quietly. "I wasn't just a passenger... I was meant to lead them, and I implore you now to help me understand the reason why."

texts.zh:
方舟舰已恢复运转，那些沉睡已久的系统立即响应塞拉伦涅的出现。修复的数据库证实了她记忆中的猜想：她自幼便接受培养，旨在引导这艘飞船以及曾经生活在其中的子民。

最后一封音频日志幸存了下来。一个沉着而熟悉的女声谈论着继承协议，以及一个必须被保护的孩子。在方舟舰开始瓦解之际，她下令发射了逃生舱。

“那个声音……”塞拉伦涅低声细语道。“我认得它。她曾是……我。或者说我是以她为原型的。一个克隆体……这就是为什么我能活下来。她想要拯救她自己。”

无论曾是什么将这艘船带入黑暗，现在它已在我们的旗帜下航行，并由重掌大权的继承人管理。
texts.en:
The Arkship is restored, its long-dormant systems immediately responding to Seralune. Recovered databanks confirm what her memories only suggested: she was raised to guide this vessel and the people who once lived within its hull.

One final audio log survives. A woman's calm, familiar voice speaks of succession protocols and a child who must be protected. She orders the escape pod to launch as the Arkship begins to break apart.

"That voice..." Seralune whispers. "I know it. She was... me. Or I was made from her. A clone... That is why I survived. She wanted to save herself."

Whatever carried this ship into the dark, it now flies under our banner, and the stewardship of the heir who has reclaimed it.

texts.zh:
随着塞拉伦涅的离去，她所承载的脆弱记忆之迹也已归于沉寂。她曾追寻的真相，如今再也无法找回。

她的故事在此终结，虽未完结，但并未被遗忘。
texts.en:
With Seralune gone, the fragile trail of memories she carried has faded into silence. Whatever truths she sought can no longer be recovered.

Her story ends here, unfinished, but not forgotten.

texts.zh:
坐标指向了一艘巨大飞船的残骸，其上层结构与标准的方舟舰设计相符。

初步探测结果表明发生了灾难性的内部故障。全面调查可能会发现与塞拉伦涅恢复的记忆相关的线索。
texts.en:
The coordinates led to the remains of a massive vessel, its superstructure consistent with standard Arkship design.

Preliminary readings suggest catastrophic internal failure. A full investigation may uncover traces linked to Seralune's recovered memories.

texts.zh: 重建破碎的飞船并非易事，但这样做或许能揭示塞拉伦涅的起源，以及她注定要继承的遗产。
texts.en: Rebuilding the shattered vessel will be difficult, but doing so may reveal the origins of Seralune and the legacy she was meant to inherit.
